setup.text: A massive lump of feast dough rests on Toby's counter, too large for the shop's standard scales. Toby picks up a smooth river stone and presses it against the dough without a word.

option_a.text:
The player watches the stone settle against the dough. "How do you get it even?"

Toby adjusts his grip without looking up. "Stone does that part."

option_b.text: The player hands Toby a second river stone. The dough parts clean into matched measures.

option_c.text: The player picks up a single berry from a nearby bowl and sets it where the stone would go instead. Toby glances at the berry, then back at the dough.
